# SVG rendering dependencies

SnapStudio includes these unmodified libraries for rendering SVG tool artwork:

| Library | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SVG.NET (`Svg`) | 3.4.8 | Microsoft Public License | https://github.com/svg-net/SVG |
| ExCSS | 4.2.3 | MIT | https://github.com/TylerBrinks/ExCSS |

SVG.NET copyright: 2009 Microsoft; 2011 vvvv Group; 2021 SVG.NET Contributors.
The corresponding license texts are included in this directory and distributed
with the app under `Docs/ThirdParty`.
